observations: All seven Workforce data classes currently forbid generalTelemetry. Reuse this deny-by-default boundary.

today-read-access, timesheet-read-access and request-decision currently pass raw caught error objects to console.error. This source review establishes an exposure path, not evidence of a runtime leak.
cron workforce-no-show-review emits error.name from arbitrary Error instances; names are not necessarily a finite allowlist.
sensitive-operation-log already provides a finite operation vocabulary without error objects.
proposed_change: Extend fixed operation vocabulary for four discovered catch sites.
Replace error-object/error.name console calls with fixed operation labels, preserving existing denied/unavailable responses.
Add thrown error canaries containing synthetic coordinates, reasons, tenant/employee references, tokens and nested causes; assert complete absence from captured log arguments.
Retain four-entitlement behavior, Route isolation and no telemetry transport; review current remaining log surfaces before any broader metrics wiring.
dependencies: Fresh ownership/ref and Support path inventory before edits
Bounded source tests and independent review
